```{=html}
<section class="page-hero">
  <h1>Application</h1>
  <p>Apply to present a poster, give a contributed talk or attend QSYI 2027</p>
</section>
```

QSYI 2027 welcomes researchers from **India and abroad** working in any area of quantum science and technology. **Participation is by application.** The organizing committee will review every application and select participants on the basis of **scientific merit** and **relevance** to the [themes](index.html#themes) of the symposium.

## How it works

```{=html}
<ol class="steps">
  <li><strong>Apply</strong> using the <a href="#application-form">application form</a> before the deadline.</li>
  <li>The <strong>organizing committee</strong> reviews all applications and selects the participants.</li>
  <li><strong>Selected participants</strong> receive an email with the decision and a <strong>link to pay the registration fee</strong>.</li>
  <li>Your <strong>registration is complete</strong> once the fee is paid.</li>
</ol>
```

## Types of application

```{=html}
<div class="qgrid qgrid-3">
  <div class="qcard">
    <h3>Poster presentation</h3>
    <p>For <strong>PhD students and postdocs</strong>. The poster sessions are a chance to discuss your work with the speakers and other participants.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="qcard">
    <h3>Contributed talk</h3>
    <p>For <strong>early-career principal investigators</strong>, such as assistant professors and junior group leaders. <strong>Four</strong> contributed talks of 20 minutes each will be selected.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="qcard">
    <h3>Participation</h3>
    <p>For <strong>students, postdocs, faculty and industry researchers</strong> who would like to attend the talks, colloquia and poster sessions without presenting.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Registration fee

```{=html}
<div class="qgrid qgrid-3">
  <div class="qcard stat"><div class="num">₹2,000</div><div class="lbl">Students and postdocs</div></div>
  <div class="qcard stat"><div class="num">₹3,000</div><div class="lbl">Faculty</div></div>
  <div class="qcard stat"><div class="num">₹5,000</div><div class="lbl">Industry delegates</div></div>
</div>
```

The registration fee is paid **only after selection**. Selected participants will receive a **payment link by email**. There is [no registration fee]{.hl-blue} for invited speakers and their accompanying group members.

## Key dates

```{=html}
<ul class="dates">
  <li><span>Application deadline (participants who need a visa to visit India)</span><span class="when">To be announced</span></li>
  <li><span>Notification of selection (participants who need a visa to visit India)</span><span class="when">To be announced</span></li>
  <li><span>Application deadline (participants who do not need a visa)</span><span class="when">To be announced</span></li>
  <li><span>Notification of selection (participants who do not need a visa)</span><span class="when">To be announced</span></li>
  <li><span>Symposium</span><span class="when">March 15 to 19, 2027</span></li>
</ul>
```

If you **need a visa** to visit India, please apply by the [earlier deadline]{.hl}. A conference visa can be requested only after the symposium is cleared by the [Ministry of External Affairs](https://www.mea.gov.in/), Government of India, and this clearance takes time.

## What you will need

- Your **name**, **affiliation**, **position** and **email address**
- The **type of application**: poster, contributed talk or participation
- For posters and contributed talks, a **title** and an **abstract**

## Accommodation

The organizers will arrange accommodation for **invited speakers and their accompanying group members**.

For **selected PhD students and postdocs**, we will reserve a **limited number of rooms** in the IIT Madras hostels. You can request a room in the application form, and the room charges are paid by the participants.

We request all other participants to **make their own arrangements**. For travel information, see the [Visit Info](visit.html) page.
